observations.value: 3-panel collage: top panel shows flat beaded bracelet, bottom left shows bracelet open, bottom right shows bracelet on wrist
made of small beads, pixelated design style
metal slide clasp with brass-colored finish, on both ends of flat bracelet
front design has blue sky with white clouds, multiple colorful houses, a figure, pink pig-like shapes
back design (visible on open bracelet) has blue sky, white clouds, pink pig-like shapes, light blue building with windows
bottom right panel shows bracelet worn on a person's wrist, fits around the wrist
solid dark blue background in all panels
houses in design have colors: white, red, orange, turquoise, yellow, brown
pixelated figure with orange hair, red clothing, positioned among houses on front design
pink pig-like pixelated shapes on right side of front design, also on back design of open bracelet
blue beaded sky with small white cloud beads in front and back designs
wide beaded bracelet, covers a portion of the wrist when worn
bottom left panel shows open bracelet with metal clasp in center, two ends connected by clasp
lower edge of beaded design has brown beads as border in front design
houses have black window details, some with yellow accents on windows
each panel has a rounded corner border
person's wrist in bottom right panel has light skin tone
